name: Nota
tagline: A music school and studio that teaches you to play what you want to listen to
niche: Music school: guitar, piano, vocals, drums, dutar; recording studio

listing.description: A website for a music school, recording studio or rehearsal space. A spinning record on the first screen, instruments as playlist tracks and a live equaliser.

seo.title: Nota — music school and recording studio in Tashkent
seo.description: Guitar, piano, vocal, drum and dutar lessons for kids from 6 and adults. One-to-one and in groups, student concerts and our own recording studio.
seo.answer: Nota is a music school and studio at 12 Afrosiyob Street in Tashkent. We teach guitar, piano, vocals, drums and dutar to kids from 6 and adults from scratch. A 45-minute one-to-one lesson is 150,000 sum, an 8-lesson pass 1,040,000 sum, a trial lesson 50,000 sum. An hour in the recording studio with an engineer is 250,000 sum.

sections.title: Play your own song
sections.subtitle: You’ll play your first song on guitar or piano within a month — teachers start with the music you love and pick up the notation along the way.

sections.label: About
sections.title: A school for playing, not passing exams
sections.text: Nota was founded by session musicians in 2017. We don’t prepare you for conservatory exams — we teach you to play: in a band, on stage, for yourself. Five soundproofed classrooms, a rehearsal room with drums and amps, and a studio where students record their first track.

sections.label: Instruments
sections.title: The lesson playlist
sections.intro: Lessons are 45 minutes one-to-one or 60 minutes in a group of up to four.

items.title: Guitar
items.text: Acoustic and electric: chords, strumming, solos. Your first song by the third lesson.

items.title: Piano
items.text: Classical and modern arrangements, playing from chords and sight-reading.

items.title: Vocals
items.text: Breathing, support, range and mic technique. Pop, jazz and variety.

items.title: Drums
items.text: Rhythm, grooves and fills on a real kit in a soundproofed room.

items.title: Dutar
items.text: Uzbek traditional music with a teacher who performs maqom.

items.title: Recording studio
items.text: Recording vocals and instruments, mixing and mastering with an engineer.

items.name: Trial
features: A plan for the first month

items.name: Group
features: A spot in the student concert

items.quote: At 32 I thought it was too late — it wasn’t. Six months later I sang at the student concert; my hands only shook for the first ten seconds.
items.author: Kamola

items.quote: My son recorded his first track in the school studio and now sends it to every relative.
items.author: Ulugbek

items.q: Do I need my own instrument?
items.a: Not for lessons — every room has instruments. For practising at home we’ll help you pick an affordable one.

items.q: From what age do you teach?
items.a: Piano and vocals from 6, guitar and drums from 8. Adults at any age.

items.q: Do I need to read music?
items.a: No. We start with songs by ear and tabs and add notation gradually.

items.q: Can I rent the studio without lessons?
items.a: Yes, the studio and rehearsal room can be booked by the hour on Telegram.

sections.label: Book
sections.title: Let’s start with a trial lesson
sections.text: Tell us the instrument, age and a time that suits you — we’ll match you with a teacher and send free slots.
